about: Every outside work the tutor's knowledge draws on: the credits and the bibliography in one place. eligible 'ship' = its license lets the text be shipped in Tu-Torus, free or sold, with the attribution given here; 'cite' = read and learned from, credited and pointed to, never shipped. 'files' lists what is actually shipped from a source (paths under server/knowledge). Checked by server/test/knowledge-sources.test.mjs; credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt by scripts/third-party-notices.cjs. Licenses checked 2026-10-08. If a link dies, use 'find' (DOI, ISBN or arXiv ID), or 'archive' for the last saved copy.
